rationale: Motor vehicle collision with damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injuries sustained from the impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was totaled in a high-impact rear-end collision on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday; the other driver struck at ~35 mph with no braking. Claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is on the police report.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other driver traveling at ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
